classification.difficultyReason: Distinguish direct side/angle calculations from the part requiring a cosine-rule side before inverse sine.

content.prompt: Find the unknown value, round lengths to 2 d.p. and angles to the nearest degree.

spec.description: Unlettered black triangle with lower-left, top and lower-right vertices. Base slopes slightly down to the right. Black interior arc at the top. Source drawing is not to scale.
spec.mathematics: Left sloping side 12 cm; right sloping side 15 cm; included top angle 85 degrees; lower side x cm.

spec.description: Unlettered black triangle with lower-left, top and lower-right vertices. Base slopes slightly down to the right. Black arc marks the top unknown angle. Source drawing is not to scale.
spec.mathematics: Left sloping side 15 cm; right sloping side 12 cm; lower side 17 cm; top angle x degrees.

spec.description: Unlettered black triangle with slightly descending lower side. Top angle has a black arc; lower-left unknown has a bright red arc and black label. Source drawing is not to scale.
spec.mathematics: Right sloping side 12 cm; lower side 15 cm; top angle 85 degrees; lower-left angle x degrees; left side unlabelled. Unknown-angle arc #FF0000.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}\frac{\sin x}{12}&=\frac{\sin85^\circ}{15}\\\sin x&=\frac{12\sin85^\circ}{15}\\x&=\sin^{-1}\left(\frac{12\sin85^\circ}{15}\right)\\x&\approx53^\circ\end{align*}$$
The supplementary angle would give an angle sum greater than $180^\circ$.

spec.description: Unlettered black triangle with slightly descending lower side. Top angle has a black arc; lower-right unknown has a bright red arc and black label. Source drawing is not to scale.
spec.mathematics: Left sloping side 12 cm; right sloping side 15 cm; included top angle 85 degrees; lower-right angle x degrees; lower side unlabelled. Unknown-angle arc #FF0000.

answer.worked:
Let $b$ be the lower side length in centimetres.
$$\begin{align*}b^2&=12^2+15^2-2(12)(15)\cos85^\circ\\b&=\sqrt{12^2+15^2-2(12)(15)\cos85^\circ}\\\frac{\sin x}{12}&=\frac{\sin85^\circ}{b}\\\sin x&=\frac{12\sin85^\circ}{b}\\x&=\sin^{-1}\left(\frac{12\sin85^\circ}{\sqrt{12^2+15^2-2(12)(15)\cos85^\circ}}\right)\\x&\approx41^\circ\end{align*}$$
The supplementary angle would give an angle sum greater than $180^\circ$.
